family.$comment: Two typefaces, Fredoka and JetBrains Mono. Everything after the first name in each stack is a fallback for before the webfont loads — not a third face in the system.

size.$comment: Named by px so the ramp is self-documenting; VALUES are rem (name ÷ 16) so type honours the visitor's browser font-size setting, which px silently ignores. Every step lands on the 4px grid the spacing scale uses, so type and space stay commensurate.

18.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid (like 14), for body-large / small subheads

22.comment: utility step — off the 4px grid, sits between h5 (20) and h4 (24)

hero.comment: container-query driven headline, above the fixed ramp
